name: promote-hello
note: ship.mjs promote(): manifestText runtime k8s at <name>.apps.inevitable.fyi

planter.appYaml:
# What redone-hello needs from the platform. Its build renders k8s/platform/ from this on every build of
# main (arugula-salad/planter, platform-app/render.mjs, says what each key gives).
name: redone-hello
health: /health
runtime: k8s
needs:
  domain: [redone-hello.apps.inevitable.fyi]
  telemetry: true

files.k8s/platform/deployment.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (the app). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redone-hello
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: redone-hello
spec:
  # Stateless: two replicas, rolled.
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: redone-hello
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: redone-hello
    spec:
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: ghcr
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      # The image runs as the numeric user 1000 (the Dockerfile's USER 1000:1000); a root or named
      # user fails runAsNonRoot with CreateContainerConfigError.
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: redone-hello
          image: ghcr.io/arugula-salad/redone-hello
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - { name: PORT, value: "8080" }
            - { name: HOST, value: 0.0.0.0 }
            # Where an OpenTelemetry SDK sends traces (Tempo), and what it calls the app. An app
            # without one ignores them.
            - { name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, value: "http://tempo.tempo.svc:4318" }
            - { name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL, value: http/protobuf }
            - { name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, value: redone-hello }
            - { name: OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES, value: "service.namespace=planter-apps,deployment.environment=prod" }
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: { path: /health, port: http }
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet: { path: /health, port: http }
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests: { cpu: 10m, memory: 32Mi }
            limits: { memory: 256Mi }
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: [ALL]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: 256Mi
files.k8s/platform/service.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (the app's Service). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redone-hello
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: redone-hello
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: redone-hello
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
files.k8s/platform/ingressroute.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (https://redone-hello.apps.inevitable.fyi). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
# https://redone-hello.apps.inevitable.fyi, with port 80 redirected, on the fleet's certificate for *.apps.inevitable.fyi
# (planter-apps-wildcard-inevitable). *.inevitable.fyi resolves to the cluster, so there is no DNS step either.
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRoute
metadata:
  name: redone-hello-inevitable
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: redone-hello
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - websecure
  routes:
    - match: Host(`redone-hello.apps.inevitable.fyi`)
      kind: Rule
      services:
        - name: redone-hello
          port: 80
  tls:
    secretName: planter-apps-wildcard-inevitable
---
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRoute
metadata:
  name: redone-hello-inevitable-http
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: redone-hello
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - web
  routes:
    - match: Host(`redone-hello.apps.inevitable.fyi`)
      kind: Rule
      middlewares:
        # home-cloud's shared redirect middleware.
        - name: redirect-https
          namespace: default
      services:
        - name: redone-hello
          port: 80
files.k8s/platform/kustomization.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (the list of what it renders). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - deployment.yaml
  - service.yaml
  - ingressroute.yaml
  - dashboard.yaml
